title: Doing Well by Doing Good: Improving Retail Store Performance with Responsible Scheduling Practices at the Gap, Inc.
authors: Saravanan Kesavan; Susan J. Lambert; Joan C. Williams; Pradeep K. Pendem
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment with a single intervention start (November 2015) in 28 stores; treat = store_treatment x time_treatment is a two-group pre/post DiD with one adoption date. Regressions also include the time-varying control log_traffic. No staggered adoption.
design_notes: Tables 2 and 4: areg log_y treat log_traffic i.dept_name, absorb(date_hour) vce(cl dept_name_date) on hourly store data. Table 3: 2SLS LATE with TreatAdoption instrumented by log weeks since intervention. Table 5: logit on employee shift outcomes. The 'staggered' full-text hit likely refers to gradual adoption of intervention components (Figure 3), not staggered treatment timing.
estimators_reported: ITT TWFE DiD (areg, single date, with log_traffic control)

ineligible_specs.reason: single intervention date; time-varying control log_traffic; IV and logit

screener_notes: Package contains code (Stata do-file, R script), a Stata log and a README only; Gap, Inc. data are under NDA.
